blocks.text: The Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (Famas) Awards has unveiled the contenders for its 74th edition, with Charo Santos, Carlo Aquino, “I’mPerfect” and “Sunshine” among the nominees vying in the major categories. Santos bagged a nomination for the best actress award for her performance in “Only We Know.” Also contending for the accolade are Maricel Soriano (“Meet, Greet, & Bye”), Krystel Go (“I’mPerfect”), Angelica Panganiban (“Unmarry”) and Maris Racal (“Sunshine”). Aquino’s portrayal in “Bar Boys: After School” earned him a nomination for the best actor honor, competing with Jericho Rosales (“Quezon”), Piolo Pascual (“Manila’s Finest”), Earl Jonathan Amaba (“I’mPerfect”) […]...
